description:
Does my listing have what today's best sellers have? Quick check of a listing, a technical sheet or a draft.
(¿Tiene mi ficha lo que tienen hoy los más vendidos de mi categoría?)

Every Scan category (`solo_scan` in wintraits_categorias_disponibles; use wintraits_buscar_categoria to find the
code): a snapshot of today's best sellers against the rest, not a prediction. `indice_scan` is the Wintraits Scan Index (0-100: how much of the
best sellers' distinguishing traits the listing has, weighting the top-ranked sellers more; 100 = the most
complete best-seller listing today; `puntos` is the raw 0-100 score before that scaling; only the traits readable
from the listing count), with the middle
half of best sellers and of the rest (out of sample); null if fewer than 3 traits can be read. `zona` says where it
falls: "mas_vendidos" (best sellers' zone), "entre" (in between), "resto" (the rest's zone) or "por_encima" (well
above the best sellers: it mentions more traits than usual, and adding more does not bring it closer to them; never
present it as better than the best sellers). Always name it
"Wintraits Scan Index" with its best sellers' band (`texto`); give the user its `frase` and `zona_frase`; `metodo` links to how it is computed. `cifras` gives, for images, bullets, title and description length and price, the listing's value
(`tu_ficha`) next to the median and middle half of best sellers and of the rest. Each trait says how often it appears
among best sellers and the rest, and `lo_tiene` = true/false if it can be read from the listing, null if the user
must check it. `te_faltan` lists the listing traits more frequent among best sellers that the listing lacks.
`indice_scan.partes` splits the index into producto and presentacion (null with a `motivo` when it cannot be
computed, never 0). The listing does not need to be on Amazon: a draft or the page of another shop works too.
Match categories (`disponibles`) also accept it, but wintraits_diagnosticar_producto gives more.

Args:
    titulo: listing title.
    categoria: Scan category id (e.g. "hidratantes"; see wintraits_categorias_disponibles).
    pais: country code (e.g. "ES").
    vinetas: bullet points of the listing.
    descripcion: listing description.
    num_imagenes: number of images, if known.
    video: whether the listing has a video, if known.
    precio_eur: selling price in euros, if known.
    ficha_tecnica: technical sheet text (no online listing), used when `titulo` is empty: only the product part
        of the index is computed; `partes.presentacion` comes with valor null and motivo "sin_ficha_de_tienda".
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
